items.title: Jane Monheit interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, August 20, 2010
items.q: And my husband and I, since Jack was born, were like aww wouldn’t it be great if he’s a bass player

ctx.x: That’s a good thing to be obsessed with. I mean for me the bass starts it all.

And my husband and I, since Jack was born, were like aww wouldn’t it be great if he’s a bass player, then it would just be like the family band. Dad on drums, Mom singing and baby bass player, grandpa playing the piano. Perfection. It’d be neat.
